title: int:Invoice
description: Individual invoice issued to an Actor for energy services within a billing period. Child of Billing.

invoiceId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:invoiceId. UUID v4.

billingId.description: FK to parent Billing record. IRI: int:billingId. UUID v4.

invoiceIssueDate.description: Date the invoice was issued. IRI: int:invoiceIssueDate. ISO 8601 with timezone.

invoiceIssuedTo.description: FK to Actor the invoice is issued to. IRI: int:invoiceIssuedTo. UUID v4.

invoiceIssuedBy.description: FK to issuing party Actor (community operator or BLOOO). IRI: int:invoiceIssuedBy. UUID v4.

invoiceDueDate.description: Payment due date. IRI: int:invoiceDueDate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

totalAmount.description: Total invoice amount (energy + grid fee + tax). IRI: int:totalAmount.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. One invoice has one currency. IRI: int:currency.

createdAt.description: Invoice creation timestamp. IRI: int:createdAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.

updatedAt.description: Invoice last updated timestamp. IRI: int:updatedAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.

tradeIds.description: FKs to Trades covered by this invoice. IRI: int:tradeIds. UUID v4 array.

paymentIds.description: FKs to Payments for this invoice. IRI: int:paymentIds. UUID v4 array.
